title: Rosemary Beach "Grand Terre" 18 N Green Turtle Lane (Main House)
h1: Rosemary Beach "Grand Terre" 18 N Green Turtle Lane (Main House)
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the private beach- Access to neighborhood pools- Short walk to Rosemary Beach town square- 1 Vehicle Garage- Private heated pool **Pool heating available October 1-May 1 for $35 per day**- Private courtyard- Balconies and covered porches- 4 Adult bikes- Washer and Dryer- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: An enchanting Gulf escape awaits at Grande Terre. Tucked within the charming Rosemary Beach community, this thoughtfully designed home accommodates 12 guests with 4 beautiful bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms. Enjoy strolling through the idyllic town square’s local shops, relaxing on the sugar-soft sand beach, and discovering the numerous family-friendly activities—including golfing, fishing, and biking. Guests will love savoring the tranquil atmosphere of the private courtyard from the inviting waters of the heated pool or the comfy, cushioned porch swings.Flourishing flora and a sprawling front porch evoke a sense of peace as guests arrive at this 2-story property. Venture inside to find golden hardwood floors and a mix of contemporary and classic coastal decor. The living space’s L-shaped sofa and striped armchairs offer cozy seating for gathering around the TV after a day of fun outside. The spacious, open kitchen encourages guests to showcase their inner chef, with granite countertops, high-end appliances, and a 4-stool breakfast bar that’s perfect for hosting friends or mini taste testers. Indulge in freshly-made meals at the wooden dining table for 6 beneath the glow of the Capiz shell pendant light. The star of the home is the brick-paved courtyard and patio, complete with a private tiled pool, 2 porch swings designed for whiling away the hours, and a 4-person alfresco table. As the night comes to a close, wind down in the guest bedroom featuring a plush king bed and private bathroom.The second-floor primary bedroom welcomes relaxation with a king bed, private bathroom, sitting area, and glass doors that lead onto the front and back porches. Also on this level is a lovely guest bedroom with 2 queen beds and access to the porch overlooking the pool, as well as a kid-friendly bunk room featuring 2 built-in twin-over-twin bunks.Grand Terre offers a delightful retreat for enjoying Rosemary Beach in elevated luxury. Garage parking for 1 vehicle and 4 complimentary adult bikes make it easy to explore. For beach access, guests can choose between multiple dedicated entry points for the community or the public beach access at the end of Winston Lane. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 12):FIRST FLOORGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateGuest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboGuest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboGuests also have access to these Rosemary Beach amenities:- Coquina Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm.- Sky Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 6 am to 10 pm (Adult Only Hours, 6 am-9 am and 8 pm-10 pm)- Cabana Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm.- Barbados Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm.*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Your rental property may share a courtyard or lot with a carriage house or main house that is owner-occupied or rented to separate guests from your party.

Tucked within the charming Rosemary Beach community, this thoughtfully designed home accommodates 12 guests with 4 beautiful bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms. Enjoy strolling through the idyllic town square’s local shops, relaxing on the sugar-soft sand beach, and discovering the numerous family-friendly activities—including golfing, fishing, and biking. Guests will love savoring the tranquil atmosphere of the private courtyard from the inviting waters of the heated pool or the comfy, cushioned porch swings. Flourishing flora and a sprawling front porch evoke a sense of peace as guests arrive at this 2-story property. Venture inside to find golden hardwood floors and a mix of contemporary and classic coastal decor. The living space’s L-shaped sofa and striped armchairs offer cozy seating for gathering around the TV after a day of fun outside. The spacious, open kitchen encourages guests to showcase their inner chef, with granite countertops, high-end appliances, and a 4-stool breakfast bar that’s perfect for hosting friends or mini taste testers. Indulge in freshly-made meals at the wooden dining table for 6 beneath the glow of the Capiz shell pendant light. The star of the home is the brick-paved courtyard and patio, complete with a private tiled pool, 2 porch swings designed for whiling away the hours, and a 4-person alfresco table. As the night comes to a close, wind down in the guest bedroom featuring a plush king bed and private bathroom. The second-floor primary bedroom welcomes relaxation with a king bed, private bathroom, sitting area, and glass doors that lead onto the front and back porches. Also on this level is a lovely guest bedroom with 2 queen beds and access to the porch overlooking the pool, as well as a kid-friendly bunk room featuring 2 built-in twin-over-twin bunks. Grand Terre offers a delightful retreat for enjoying Rosemary Beach in elevated luxury. Garage parking for 1 vehicle and 4 complimentary adult bikes make it easy to explore. For beach access, guests can choose between multiple dedicated entry points for the community or the public beach access at the end of Winston Lane. Book today!
